# amiga-hardware reference index

OCS/ECS custom chips (Agnus, Denise, Paula) and the two 8520 CIAs, distilled from the
Amiga Hardware Reference Manual and checked against the NDK 3.9 hardware includes.
AGA-only registers are in the amiga-aga skill.

- [Sources](SOURCE.md) · [Errata](errata.md) · [Register table (TSV)](data/registers.tsv)

## Guides

- [Audio: Paula's four channels](topics/audio.md) — Playing samples with audio DMA: format, period/volume maths, queuing, modulation, filter.
- [Blitter: copies, masks, fills and lines](topics/blitter.md) — How to program the blitter for block copies, cookie-cut bobs, area fill and line drawing.
- [CIAs and I/O: timers, keyboard, joystick, mouse, serial, parallel, floppy lines](topics/cia-and-io.md) — How to use the two 8520 CIAs and Paula's port/serial registers from bare-metal code.
- [Copper: display coprocessor](topics/copper.md) — How to encode, build, start and time copper lists (HRM chapter 2).
- [ECS: Enhanced Chip Set](topics/ecs.md) — What ECS (8372 Agnus, 8373 Denise) adds over OCS, how to detect it, BEAMCON0 and DIWHIGH.
- [Interrupts, beam timing and DMA arbitration](topics/interrupts-and-dma.md) — Interrupt levels and servicing, beam timing, and how DMA channels share the chip bus.
- [Amiga memory map](topics/memory-map.md) — Where chip RAM, CIAs, custom chips, slow RAM, AUTOCONFIG space and ROM are mapped.
- [Amiga hardware overview (OCS/ECS)](topics/overview.md) — The chips, clocks, memory types and register access rules behind every bare-metal program.
- [Playfields: bitplanes, display window, scrolling](topics/playfields.md) — Bitplane displays: modes, window/fetch formulas, modulos, scrolling, EHB, HAM, interlace.
- [Hardware sprites](topics/sprites.md) — How to build, position, colour, attach, reuse and collide the eight hardware sprites.
- [Taking over the system (and giving it back)](topics/system-takeover.md) — Bare-metal startup/exit sequence for games and demos, plus the OS-friendly alternative.
- [Zorro expansion and AUTOCONFIG](topics/zorro-autoconfig.md) — Zorro II/III address spaces, the AUTOCONFIG handshake, and how software finds boards.

## Register files

- [Custom chips: audio registers](registers/audio.md) — Paula has four 8-bit audio channels: 0 and 3 share one stereo output, 1 and 2 the other (which side is which is disputed between sources, see stereo layout).
- [Custom chips: blitter registers](registers/blitter.md) — The blitter is a word-based DMA device in Agnus with three sources (A, B, C) and one destination (D).
- [8520 CIA registers (CIA-A and CIA-B)](registers/cia.md) — Two MOS 8520 Complex Interface Adapters.
- [Custom chips: Copper registers](registers/copper.md) — The Copper is the Agnus coprocessor that executes a list of MOVE / WAIT / SKIP instructions in chip RAM, synchronised to the video beam.
- [Custom chips: floppy disk registers](registers/disk.md) — Paula reads and writes raw MFM (or GCR) bit streams by DMA.
- [Custom chips: DMA control and beam counter](registers/dma-beam.md) — Addresses are 68k addresses (`$DFF000` + chip offset).
- [ECS registers: programmable beam, UHRES, DIWHIGH, DENISEID](registers/ecs.md) — The Enhanced Chip Set is the 8372 "hires" Agnus plus the 8373 Denise (standard in the A3000, installable in the A500 and A2000); AGA's Alice and Lisa keep every register here.
- [Custom chips: controller ports and serial port](registers/input-serial.md) — Controller ports: register "0" (JOY0DAT, POT0DAT, CIA-A `CIAB_GAMEPORT0`) is the left connector, labelled PORT 1 / mouse port; register "1" (JOY1DAT, POT1DAT, `CIAB_GAMEPORT1`)...
- [Custom chips: interrupt enable and request](registers/interrupts.md) — Paula collects every interrupt source into INTREQ, masks it with INTENA and drives the 680x0 interrupt priority lines (levels 1-6).
- [Custom chips: playfield (bitplane) registers](registers/playfield.md) — All playfield registers are write-only: keep shadow copies of anything you need to read back.
- [Custom chips: sprite and collision registers](registers/sprites.md) — Eight hardware sprites, 16 pixels wide, 3 colours + transparent each (15 colours when an even/odd pair is attached).

## Registers by address

Width L rows are the 32-bit names of H/L pointer pairs (one `move.l` from the CPU).

| `$BFD100` | [PRB](registers/cia.md#ciab-prb) | B | OCS | read/write (all outputs, DDRB = `$FF`) | Floppy drive control: motor, drive selects, side, step direction and step pulse. |

| `$DFF1B6` | [COLOR27](registers/playfield.md#colorxx) | W | OCS | write | 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. |
| `$DFF1B8` | [COLOR28](registers/playfield.md#colorxx) | W | OCS | write | 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. |
| `$DFF1BA` | [COLOR29](registers/playfield.md#colorxx) | W | OCS | write | 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. |
| `$DFF1BC` | [COLOR30](registers/playfield.md#colorxx) | W | OCS | write | 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. |
| `$DFF1BE` | [COLOR31](registers/playfield.md#colorxx) | W | OCS | write | 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. |
| `$DFF1C0` | [HTOTAL](registers/ecs.md#htotal) | W | ECS | write | Highest horizontal colour-clock count: a line lasts HTOTAL+1 colour clocks. |
| `$DFF1C2` | [HSSTOP](registers/ecs.md#hsstop) | W | ECS | write | Horizontal position (colour clocks) where HSYNC ends. |
| `$DFF1C4` | [HBSTRT](registers/ecs.md#hbstrt) | W | ECS | write | Horizontal position (colour clocks) where horizontal blanking starts. |
| `$DFF1C6` | [HBSTOP](registers/ecs.md#hbstop) | W | ECS | write | Horizontal position (colour clocks) where horizontal blanking ends. |
| `$DFF1C8` | [VTOTAL](registers/ecs.md#vtotal) | W | ECS | write | Highest line number: the vertical counter resets after it (VTOTAL+1 lines per field). |
| `$DFF1CA` | [VSSTOP](registers/ecs.md#vsstop) | W | ECS | write | Line number where vertical sync ends. |
| `$DFF1CC` | [VBSTRT](registers/ecs.md#vbstrt) | W | ECS | write | Line number where vertical blanking starts. |
| `$DFF1CE` | [VBSTOP](registers/ecs.md#vbstop) | W | ECS | write | Line number where vertical blanking ends (bits 10-0). |
| `$DFF1D0` | [SPRHSTRT](registers/ecs.md#sprhstrt-sprhstop) | W | ECS | write | First and last line of the UHRES sprite pointer fetch. |
| `$DFF1D2` | [SPRHSTOP](registers/ecs.md#sprhstrt-sprhstop) | W | ECS | write | First and last line of the UHRES sprite pointer fetch. |
| `$DFF1D4` | [BPLHSTRT](registers/ecs.md#bplhstrt-bplhstop) | W | ECS | write | First and last line of the UHRES bitplane pointer fetch. |
| `$DFF1D6` | [BPLHSTOP](registers/ecs.md#bplhstrt-bplhstop) | W | ECS | write | First and last line of the UHRES bitplane pointer fetch. |
| `$DFF1D8` | [HHPOSW](registers/ecs.md#hhposw) | W | ECS | write | Write the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter. |
| `$DFF1DA` | [HHPOSR](registers/ecs.md#hhposr) | W | ECS | read | Read the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter. |
| `$DFF1DC` | [BEAMCON0](registers/ecs.md#beamcon0) | W | ECS | write | Beam counter control: variable sync/blank, PAL/NTSC decodes and sync polarities. |
| `$DFF1DE` | [HSSTRT](registers/ecs.md#hsstrt) | W | ECS | write | Horizontal position (colour clocks) where HSYNC starts. |
| `$DFF1E0` | [VSSTRT](registers/ecs.md#vsstrt) | W | ECS | write | Line number where vertical sync starts. |
| `$DFF1E2` | [HCENTER](registers/ecs.md#hcenter) | W | ECS | write | Horizontal position (colour clocks) of VSYNC on long (interlace) fields. |
| `$DFF1E4` | [DIWHIGH](registers/ecs.md#diwhigh) | W | ECS | write | Upper bits of the display window start and stop positions (removes the OCS limits). |
| `$DFF1E6` | [BPLHMOD](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | W | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1E8` | [SPRHPT](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | L | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1E8` | [SPRHPTH](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | W | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1EA` | [SPRHPTL](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | W | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1EC` | [BPLHPT](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | L | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1EC` | [BPLHPTH](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | W | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1EE` | [BPLHPTL](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat) | W | ECS | write | UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. |
| `$DFF1FC` | FMODE | W | AGA | write | Chip RAM fetch width for bitplanes and sprites, plus scan-doubling enables. (see the amiga-aga skill) |

## Register entries (alphabetical)

- `ADKCON` — Audio modulation, disk read/write mode and UART break control (set/clear write). → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#adkcon)
- `ADKCONR` — Read the current audio modulation, disk mode and UART break bits. → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#adkconr)
- `AUDxDAT` — Output buffer of channel x: two signed 8-bit samples played one after the other. → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#audxdat)
- `AUDxLCH, AUDxLCL` — Start address of channel x's sample; copied to the playback pointer at each block start. → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#audxlch-audxlcl)
- `AUDxLEN` — Length of channel x's sample block in words. → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#audxlen)
- `AUDxPER` — Sample period in colour clocks per sample; a smaller value plays faster (higher pitch). → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#audxper)
- `AUDxVOL` — Channel x volume, 0 (silent) to 64 (full), linear. → [registers/audio.md](registers/audio.md#audxvol)
- `BEAMCON0` — Beam counter control: variable sync/blank, PAL/NTSC decodes and sync polarities. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#beamcon0)
- `BLTAFWM` — Mask ANDed with the first word of every row of source A (a 0 bit blocks A's data). → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltafwm)
- `BLTALWM` — Mask ANDed with the last word of every row of source A. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltalwm)
- `BLTCON0` — Channel enables, A shift value and the minterm logic function of the blit. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltcon0)
- `BLTCON0L` — ECS shortcut that writes only BLTCON0 bits 7-0 (the minterms). → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltcon0l)
- `BLTCON1` — Area/line mode select, B shift, fill modes and direction; in line mode, octant and flags. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltcon1)
- `BLTDDAT` — Holds each result word until the blitter writes it to destination D. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltddat)
- `BLTSIZE` — Blit height (lines) and width (words); the write starts the blitter. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltsize)
- `BLTSIZH` — ECS blit width, 11 bits (up to 32768 pixels); the write starts the blit. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltsizh)
- `BLTSIZV` — ECS blit height, 15 bits (up to 32768 lines); written before BLTSIZH. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltsizv)
- `BLTxDAT` — Source data register: filled by DMA when the channel is enabled, otherwise a constant. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltxdat)
- `BLTxMOD` — Signed modulo added to channel x's pointer at the end of each row. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltxmod)
- `BLTxPTH, BLTxPTL` — Chip-RAM address of the next word for source A, B, C or destination D. → [registers/blitter.md](registers/blitter.md#bltxpth-bltxptl)
- `BPL1MOD` — Signed modulo added to the odd bitplane pointers (1, 3, 5) at the end of each line. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bpl1mod)
- `BPL2MOD` — Signed modulo added to the even bitplane pointers (2, 4, 6) at the end of each line. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bpl2mod)
- `BPLCON0` — Display mode: bitplane count, hires, HAM, dual playfield, interlace and genlock bits. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplcon0)
- `BPLCON1` — Horizontal scroll delay (0-15 lores pixels) for playfield 1 and playfield 2. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplcon1)
- `BPLCON2` — Playfield priority against sprites and each other, plus ECS genlock keying. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplcon2)
- `BPLCON3` — ECS enhanced display features: border blanking and border genlock transparency. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplcon3)
- `BPLHPTH, BPLHPTL, BPLHMOD, SPRHPTH, SPRHPTL, BPLHDAT, SPRHDAT` — UHRES (external VRAM) bitplane and sprite pointers, modulo and bus identifiers. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#bplhpth-bplhptl-bplhmod-sprhpth-sprhptl-bplhdat-sprhdat)
- `BPLHSTRT, BPLHSTOP` — First and last line of the UHRES bitplane pointer fetch. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#bplhstrt-bplhstop)
- `BPLxDAT` — Bitplane serialiser input words, filled by bitplane DMA and not needed by software. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplxdat)
- `BPLxPTH, BPLxPTL` — Chip-RAM address of bitplane x; it advances during display, so reload it every frame. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#bplxpth-bplxptl)
- `CIAA PRA` — Fire buttons and floppy status inputs; power LED and ROM overlay outputs. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ciaa-pra)
- `CIAA PRB` — Centronics parallel port data lines D7-D0. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ciaa-prb)
- `CIAB PRA` — Serial port handshake lines and printer status inputs. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ciab-pra)
- `CIAB PRB` — Floppy drive control: motor, drive selects, side, step direction and step pulse. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ciab-prb)
- `CLXCON` — Select the bitplanes, match values and odd sprites used for collision detection. → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#clxcon)
- `CLXDAT` — Collision flags since the last read; reading clears the register. → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#clxdat)
- `COLORxx` — 12-bit RGB palette entry `$0RGB`; COLOR00 is the background and border colour. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#colorxx)
- `COP1LCH, COP1LCL` — Address of the first Copper list; reloaded into the Copper PC at every vertical blank. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#cop1lch-cop1lcl)
- `COP2LCH, COP2LCL` — Address of the second Copper list; used only when COPJMP2 is strobed. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#cop2lch-cop2lcl)
- `COPCON` — Copper danger bit: lets the Copper write the protected low register range. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#copcon)
- `COPINS` — Copper instruction fetch identifier; also documents the MOVE/WAIT/SKIP encoding. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#copins)
- `COPJMP1` — Strobe: restart the Copper at the address held in COP1LC. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#copjmp1)
- `COPJMP2` — Strobe: restart the Copper at the address held in COP2LC. → [registers/copper.md](registers/copper.md#copjmp2)
- `CRA` — Control register A: timer A mode and the serial port direction. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#cra)
- `CRB` — Control register B: timer B mode, timer B input and TOD alarm write select. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#crb)
- `DDFSTOP` — Horizontal beam position of the last bitplane data fetch (right edge). → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#ddfstop)
- `DDFSTRT` — Horizontal beam position where bitplane data fetch starts (left edge of fetched data). → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#ddfstrt)
- `DDRA` — Data direction for port A: 1 = output, 0 = input, one bit per PRA bit. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ddra)
- `DDRB` — Data direction for port B: 1 = output, 0 = input. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#ddrb)
- `DENISEID` — Video chip revision: identifies OCS Denise, ECS Denise or AGA Lisa. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#deniseid)
- `DIWHIGH` — Upper bits of the display window start and stop positions (removes the OCS limits). → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#diwhigh)
- `DIWSTOP` — Lower-right corner of the display window (VSTOP, HSTOP), exclusive. → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#diwstop)
- `DIWSTRT` — Upper-left corner of the display window (VSTART, HSTART). → [registers/playfield.md](registers/playfield.md#diwstrt)
- `DMACON` — Enable or disable DMA channels, the DMA master switch and blitter priority. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#dmacon)
- `DMACONR` — Read the DMA enable bits plus the blitter busy and blitter zero flags. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#dmaconr)
- `DSKBYTR` — Disk byte buffer and status: one byte of the input stream at a time, plus DMA state. → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dskbytr)
- `DSKDAT` — Disk DMA data buffer for writes: two bytes on their way from RAM to the disk. → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dskdat)
- `DSKDATR` — Disk DMA data buffer for reads (early-read dummy address used by the DMA). → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dskdatr)
- `DSKLEN` — Disk DMA enable, direction and length; DMA starts only on the second enabling write. → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dsklen)
- `DSKPTH, DSKPTL` — Chip-RAM buffer address for the next disk DMA read or write. → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dskpth-dskptl)
- `DSKSYNC` — Sync word compared with the disk input stream (`$4489` for Amiga MFM). → [registers/disk.md](registers/disk.md#dsksync)
- `HBSTOP` — Horizontal position (colour clocks) where horizontal blanking ends. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hbstop)
- `HBSTRT` — Horizontal position (colour clocks) where horizontal blanking starts. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hbstrt)
- `HCENTER` — Horizontal position (colour clocks) of VSYNC on long (interlace) fields. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hcenter)
- `HHPOSR` — Read the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hhposr)
- `HHPOSW` — Write the secondary (DUAL mode) horizontal beam counter. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hhposw)
- `HSSTOP` — Horizontal position (colour clocks) where HSYNC ends. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hsstop)
- `HSSTRT` — Horizontal position (colour clocks) where HSYNC starts. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#hsstrt)
- `HTOTAL` — Highest horizontal colour-clock count: a line lasts HTOTAL+1 colour clocks. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#htotal)
- `ICR` — Interrupt flags (read, cleared by the read) and interrupt enable mask (set/clear write). → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#icr)
- `INTENA` — Enable or disable individual interrupt sources and the master interrupt enable. → [registers/interrupts.md](registers/interrupts.md#intena)
- `INTENAR` — Read which interrupt sources and the master enable are currently on. → [registers/interrupts.md](registers/interrupts.md#intenar)
- `INTREQ` — Clear serviced interrupt requests, or set a request to trigger an interrupt from software. → [registers/interrupts.md](registers/interrupts.md#intreq)
- `INTREQR` — Read which interrupt requests are pending, whether or not they are enabled. → [registers/interrupts.md](registers/interrupts.md#intreqr)
- `JOY0DAT` — Mouse counters or joystick switch bits of the left controller port (port 1, mouse). → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#joy0dat)
- `JOY1DAT` — Mouse counters or joystick switch bits of the right controller port (port 2, joystick). → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#joy1dat)
- `JOYTEST` — Write the same value into all four mouse counters at once. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#joytest)
- `POT0DAT` — Pot (paddle / analogue) counters of the left port: Y on pin 9, X on pin 5. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#pot0dat)
- `POT1DAT` — Pot counters of the right port: Y (pin 9) in bits 15-8, X (pin 5) in bits 7-0. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#pot1dat)
- `POTGO` — Direction and output data of the four pot pins (pins 5 and 9 of both ports) and pot start. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#potgo)
- `POTGOR` — Read the level of the four pot pins (right / middle mouse buttons, second fire buttons). → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#potgor)
- `REFPTR` — Dynamic RAM refresh address generator, writable only for chip testing. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#refptr)
- `SDR` — 8-bit synchronous serial shift register: CIA-A receives the keyboard; CIA-B's is unused. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#sdr)
- `SERDAT` — Serial transmit buffer: data bits plus the stop bit(s) that define the word length. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#serdat)
- `SERDATR` — Serial receive buffer and UART status. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#serdatr)
- `SERPER` — Serial baud rate divisor and 8/9-bit receive length. → [registers/input-serial.md](registers/input-serial.md#serper)
- `SPRHSTRT, SPRHSTOP` — First and last line of the UHRES sprite pointer fetch. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#sprhstrt-sprhstop)
- `SPRxCTL` — Sprite x vertical stop, attach flag and the high/low position bits. → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#sprxctl)
- `SPRxDATA` — Low-order colour bit of the 16 pixels of the current sprite line (MSB = leftmost). → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#sprxdata)
- `SPRxDATB` — High-order colour bit of the 16 pixels of the current sprite line (MSB = leftmost). → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#sprxdatb)
- `SPRxPOS` — Sprite x vertical start (low 8 bits) and horizontal start (high 8 bits). → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#sprxpos)
- `SPRxPTH, SPRxPTL` — Chip-RAM address of sprite x's data list; reload it every vertical blank. → [registers/sprites.md](registers/sprites.md#sprxpth-sprxptl)
- `STREQU` — Strobe for horizontal sync with vertical blank and equalisation pulses (Agnus to Denise). → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#strequ)
- `STRHOR` — Strobe for horizontal sync on ordinary lines (Agnus to Denise and Paula). → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#strhor)
- `STRLONG` — Strobe marking long horizontal lines (228 colour clocks NTSC), sent on alternate lines. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#strlong)
- `STRVBL` — Strobe for horizontal sync during vertical blank (Agnus to Denise). → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#strvbl)
- `TALO, TAHI` — Timer A: 16-bit down counter clocked by the E clock (or CNT); underflow sets ICR TA. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#talo-tahi)
- `TBLO, TBHI` — Timer B: 16-bit down counter; can also count timer A underflows for long delays. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#tblo-tbhi)
- `TODLOW, TODMID, TODHI` — 24-bit event counter (TOD) and alarm: CIA-A counts 50/60 Hz ticks, CIA-B counts HSYNC. → [registers/cia.md](registers/cia.md#todlow-todmid-todhi)
- `VBSTOP` — Line number where vertical blanking ends (bits 10-0). → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#vbstop)
- `VBSTRT` — Line number where vertical blanking starts. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#vbstrt)
- `VHPOSR` — Read the low 8 bits of the vertical beam position and the horizontal position. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#vhposr)
- `VHPOSW` — Write the beam counter (V7-V0, H8-H1); meant for chip test synchronisation only. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#vhposw)
- `VPOSR` — Read the long-frame flag, the Agnus chip ID and the top vertical beam position bit(s). → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#vposr)
- `VPOSW` — Write the long-frame flip-flop (bit 15) and V8, same layout as VPOSR. → [registers/dma-beam.md](registers/dma-beam.md#vposw)
- `VSSTOP` — Line number where vertical sync ends. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#vsstop)
- `VSSTRT` — Line number where vertical sync starts. → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#vsstrt)
- `VTOTAL` — Highest line number: the vertical counter resets after it (VTOTAL+1 lines per field). → [registers/ecs.md](registers/ecs.md#vtotal)
